questionAnswers.sameScope: Model accumulates separate booleans. Owner admission does not mask it (no per-view universe rule; coverage-less scopes admitted). Masked only when the foreign scope carries Coverage on a supported-available row (D2, F4 -> COVERAGE_DERIVE).
